WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) as type_avg
  FROM Products
  WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
baseline_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg) as baseline_value
  FROM type_averages
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT ta.production_type_code, ta.type_avg
  FROM type_averages ta
  WHERE ta.type_avg > (SELECT baseline_value FROM baseline_val)
),
kept_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg) as mean_kept
  FROM above_baseline
),
final_kept AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, type_avg
  FROM above_baseline ab
  WHERE ab.type_avg > (SELECT mean_kept FROM kept_mean_val)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(type_avg) as avg_type_price,
  AVG(type_avg) - (SELECT baseline_value FROM baseline_val) as avg_above_baseline,
  AVG(type_avg) - (SELECT mean_kept FROM kept_mean_val) as avg_above_kept_mean
FROM final_kept    -- Result: (829.07, 265.31, 89.20)
